SI-4_title.answer: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

NM2-1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to train a normative model to predict regional gray matter volume (GMV) from age and sex in healthy controls. The model was then applied to infer regional GMV of patients, with Z-scores calculated by quantifying the deviation between true and predicted GMV normalized by the uncertainty of prediction.
NM2-1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Following the previous studies (Bethlehem, Seidlitz, Romero-Garcia, & Trakoshis, 2020; Shan et al., 2022), we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients. For each brain region, the Z-score was obtained by quantifying the deviation between the true GMV and the predicted one then normalized by the uncertainty of prediction
NM2-1_modeling_methods.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern

NM2-2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volume (GMV) measured using voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis was the response variable. GMV was measured using CAT12 toolbox, with structural images segmented, normalized to MNI space (voxel size 1.5mm x 1.5mm x 1.5mm), nonlinearly modulated and smoothed with 6mm FWHM Gaussian kernel. Brain regions were parcellated into 246 regions based on Brainnetome atlas.
NM2-2_response_variable.supporting_text: GMV was measured with VBM analysis (Ashburner & Friston, 2000). This procedure was done using the recommended pipelines with the Computational Anatomy Toolbox (CAT12, http://dbm.neuro.uni-jena.de/cat12/). ... The structural images were segmented into gray matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid and normalized into Montreal Neurological Institute space (voxel size 1.5 mm × 1.5 mm × 1.5 mm). The structural images were nonlinearly modulated and smoothed with an 6 mm full width at half maximum Gaussian kernel

NM2-3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as the two explanatory variables (predictors) in the Gaussian process regression normative model to predict regional GMV in healthy controls.
